subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers permanently fail closed on legacy ownerless session rows, or should OpenClaw provide a supported migration or ownership-assignment path before enforcing this boundary?
rationale: The code correctly blocks cross-plugin mutation, but the behavior for already persisted ownerless rows is a deliberate compatibility and operator-policy decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Accept fail-closed ownership
options.body: Merge the current behavior, keep ownerless legacy rows editable only by non-plugin clients, and document the operator recovery path.

options.title: Require a migration path
options.body: Add a narrow, explicitly owned migration or repair flow before plugins are denied access to legacy ownerless rows.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed ownership
recommendation.body: Merge the current behavior, keep ownerless legacy rows editable only by non-plugin clients, and document the operator recovery path.
